# openmetadata_team (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata team by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_team" "platform" {
  fully_qualified_name = "platform"
}

output "platform_team_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_team.platform.id
}

output "platform_team_users" {
  value = data.openmetadata_team.platform.users
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Team fully qualified name, which equals the team name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Team UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `default_persona` (String) Fully qualified name of the team's default persona.
- `default_roles` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of roles granted to the team's users by default.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `email` (String) Contact email of the team.
- `is_joinable` (Boolean) Whether users may join the team themselves.
- `name` (String) Team name.
- `parents` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the parent teams.
- `policies` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of policies assigned to the team.
- `team_type` (String) Kind of team: Department, Division, BusinessUnit, Group or Organization.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `users` (Set of String) Names of the users that belong to the team.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
